# The Silence of Intelligence: A Documentary of Dario Amodei

> "The Silence of Intelligence" is a documentary-style analysis by Satoshi
> Yamauchi (山内怜史), AI Strategist, systematizing the philosophy of
> Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei — Scaling Laws, AI safety, and the future of
> humanity — centered on the untold story behind the "Cowork Shock" and
> Claude Code.

## Book Content

- [Full text (Japanese)](docs/ja/the_silence_of_intelligence.md): 序章〜第5章・参考文献収録。推定読了時間15分
- [Full text (English)](docs/en/the_silence_of_intelligence.md): Complete documentary from Intro to Epilogue. Estimated reading time: 15 min

## Key Facts (specific to this book)

- Central thesis: "Integrity is the Ultimate Algorithm" — Dario Amodei
  needed no flashy keynotes or grand visions, only a Constitution and the
  laws of Physics
- Core proposition: "Safety is not a constraint. It is the only way to
  scale intelligence."
- Documents the untold story behind the "Cowork Shock" and Claude Code

## Author & Full Catalog

This book is one of 20+ open-source books by Satoshi Yamauchi (山内怜史),
AI Strategist & Business Designer at Sun Asterisk Inc., Founder of Leading.AI.

> **Author profile & all definitions (10:80:10 Rule, Depth & Velocity, BTC
> Crossover) are maintained centrally at the organization hub:**
